storyline.real: Vettel leads from pole to the flag. Räikkönen, 11th on the grid, climbs to second and is within DRS range by lap 33, but his attack at turn 1 on lap 36 doesn't come off. Vettel wins by 3.333 s, with Grosjean third.

hidden.label: Win without a single push lap

eras.briefing: Bahrain, 2012. You run Vettel, leading from pole, eight laps in, five seconds clear of Grosjean's Lotus. The other Lotus, Räikkönen, started 11th and is sixth, with a set of softs he saved in qualifying. Bring Vettel home first.
